landing.heroTitle: Food, money and the future — finally in one rhythm
landing.heroSub: Nest & Nibble isn’t another app. It’s the three you already open every day, brought into one: what to cook, how much is left until payday, and what to actually do next.
landing.foodBody: Food looks at what’s already in the fridge and suggests what to cook today. Calories and macros are counted for you.
landing.foodNote: Every Sunday, Nest & Nibble builds the week’s menu and a shopping list to go with it.
landing.financeTitle: A budget that counts itself — and speaks up
landing.financeBody: Finance sorts spending into envelopes for you and tells you, honestly, how much you can spend today.
landing.financeNote: A big unplanned expense shows exactly which month it comes out of — no surprise later.
landing.futureTitle: Big goals that don’t get lost between deadlines
landing.futureBody: Plans takes what you’ve been putting off and turns it into a concrete task for today.
landing.futureNote: Tasks from Food and Finance land in Plans by themselves, no manual copying.
landing.closingTitle: One Nest & Nibble instead of three open tabs of your life
landing.closingSub: Start with any module — the rest connect themselves when you need them.
landing.freeBody: Food, Finance and Plans separately, capped at 20 tasks and recipes a month.
landing.proBody: Full rhythm: everything synced, no limits.
landing.footer: Nest & Nibble · Food, Finance and Plans in one app
